parent_objective: audit no-training controller-family decisive matrix protocol preflight result before any one-seed pilot
blocked_by: one-seed public pilot should not start until protocol preflight is audited

public_gates: M1672 must audit M1671 summary and matrix_protocol artifacts
M1672 must decide whether one-seed public plumbing pilot design is admitted
M1672 must keep training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims blocked
M1672 must not treat public protocol preflight as controller-family performance evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not repair the M1663 artifact
do not run a one-seed pilot

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M1671 no-training protocol preflight before any pilot
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if M1671 artifacts are missing
stop if protocol guardrails are violated
stop if public protocol preflight is treated as performance evidence
stop if one-seed pilot is admitted without addressing clean-package mapping risk
fallback_plan: route to protocol repair if config or artifact gaps are found
route to task-source mapping design if clean package is too L3-specific
route to one-seed pilot design only if protocol and mapping assumptions are acceptable
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1671 completed the no-training protocol preflight

admission_evidence: M1671 reports 12 configs, zero contract violations, and zero guardrail violations
allowed_updates: M1672 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest if audit admits one-seed pilot design or protocol repair

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; audit must keep current-response and current-tiled controls as required future comparisons.
history_necessity_tests: audit must confirm the protocol includes L2 current-tiled and L3 reset controls
audit must not infer history necessity from protocol preflight
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If protocol mapping is insufficient, route to repair or task-source regeneration rather than weakening self-ID standards.
allowed_claims: protocol result audit and route decision
no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1671 protocol preflight can be audited into a clear route decision before any one-seed public pilot.
success_criteria: audit verifies protocol and summary artifacts are present
audit chooses one-seed pilot design, protocol repair, or task-source mapping design
training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit treats protocol preflight as controller-family ranking evidence
audit routes directly to training replay PPO promotion private holdout or paper evidence
decision_rule: M1672 passes if it audits the M1671 protocol preflight and chooses a next route before any pilot, training, replay, PPO, promotion, or private holdout.
